personality_one_liner: A high-precision, tactical soccer manager command center engineered for instant touch response and stadium-grade clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous tactical padding with compact utility margins. Safe area respected everywhere.

do's: Use solid obsidian and graphite surfaces with high contrast borders
Prioritize operational clarity and instant glanceability for metrics
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs and translucent glass that reduce match data readability
Avoid low contrast text on dark backgrounds

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of club status, next match countdown, league standing, and quick actions.

states.loading: Centered sports spinner with pitch grass texture backdrop
states.empty: No active fixtures found. Start a new season.
states.error: Failed to sync club data. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with sticky tactical header card, next match hero card with countdown timer, squad morale bar, and quick action grid.

screens.name: Squad & Tactics
screens.purpose: Manage starting 11, player formations, tactical approach (Attacking/Defensive), and substitutions.

states.loading: Loading squad roster and tactical attributes...
states.empty: Squad is empty. Recruit players in transfer market.
states.error: Failed to load formation. Retry button.

screens.layout: Tactical pitch graphical overlay on top half with draggable player position chips, list of substitutes and stamina sliders on bottom half.

screens.name: Match Simulation
screens.purpose: Live 2D match simulator tracking possession, timeline events, tactical adjustments, and live score.
screens.layout: Top scoreboard with stadium header, center pitch 2D tactical tracker, real-time match events timeline feed, and bottom tactical adjustment buttons.

screens.name: League Table & Fixtures
screens.purpose: View current league standings, goal differences, upcoming fixtures, and recent results.

states.empty: League table will populate after week 1.
states.error: Could not connect to league server. Retry.

screens.layout: Segmented tab control for Table vs Fixtures, compact list rows with team crests, points, and form guides.

screens.name: GitHub & APK Build Center
screens.purpose: Monitor automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, download compiled Android .apk files directly.

states.error: Failed to fetch GitHub workflow status. Check token.

screens.layout: Repository status header, live build status badge card with progress indicator, and prominent direct .apk download button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functional vertical-screen Soccer Manager mobile game in Kotlin Android with Gradle 8 and JDK 21.
Include automated GitHub Actions workflow configured to compile and build the Android APK on every push.
Implement core features: Squad management, tactical formations, live match simulation with event log, league table, and CI/CD status center.
Adhere strictly to Dark-First Utility DARK personality (#121619 obsidian base, #E05A30 warm ember accent).
Ensure 48x48dp minimum touch targets, zero violet/purple/blue/navy hues, and robust loading/empty/error states.
